title: Holographic Scan Chamber with Layered Post-Processing
description: The user operates a futuristic holographic scan chamber where the PrimaryIonDrive powers a scanning beam that analyzes the Corset artifact. Through a multi-step calibration process, the user adjusts bloom intensity, chromatic aberration, film grain, vignette darkness, scan-line density, and color grading to reveal hidden structural details of the Corset under different post-processing visualization modes.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load PrimaryIonDrive.glb and Corset.glb using GLTFLoader. Position the Corset centered at origin on a reflective circular platform. Place the PrimaryIonDrive above and behind it, angled downward as if projecting a scanning beam. Add a cyan emissive cone geometry between the drive and corset to simulate the scan beam. Camera at (0, 1.5, 3.5) looking at origin with OrbitControls. Use a dark environment with subtle ambient light (0x112233) and a directional light (0xaaeeff). Set up EffectComposer with RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, and ShaderPass for custom effects. Create a dat.GUI panel with these 8 controls requiring specific valid ranges: (1) Bloom Intensity slider 0-3, default 0.5, (2) Bloom Threshold slider 0-1, default 0.8, (3) Chromatic Aberration toggle with offset uniform 0-0.02, (4) Scan Line Density slider 50-500 controlling horizontal line shader, default 200, (5) Vignette Darkness slider 0-2, default 0.8, (6) Film Grain Intensity slider 0-0.5, default 0.1, (7) Color Grading dropdown with modes Normal/Thermal/Xray/Hologram that swap LUT-style tint uniforms, (8) Scan Beam Opacity slider 0-1 controlling the cone material opacity. Write a custom ShaderPass that composites scan lines, vignette, chromatic aberration, and film grain in a single fragment shader using time-based animation for grain and scan line scrolling. The scan lines should scroll vertically over the scene. In Thermal mode tint toward orange-red, Xray mode toward inverted blue-white, Hologram mode toward green with increased scan line visibility. Validate that bloom intensity plus vignette darkness never exceeds 4.0, clamping automatically. Animate the PrimaryIonDrive with slow rotation on Y axis. The Corset should pulse emissive intensity synced to bloom. Render at window resolution with antialiasing disabled to let post-processing handle quality.
